Dear Helium D. Support Team,

I have just received my order #Shop···· today, October 26, 2026, at my
address in (address hidden).

I am writing to immediately request a return of the purchased product,
Jingle Miner BTC Hashcard (12.5 TH/s).

Upon unpacking the device and inspecting its physical specifications, I
realized that the built-in fans are specified to operate at a noise level
that is unbearable for a home or office environment. The manufacturer
documentation clearly indicates an excessive noise level, rendering the
device entirely unsuitable for my intended use. In fact, the anticipated
operational noise is so high that I am unwilling to even connect the device
to power.

As the product fails to meet my reasonable expectations for indoor
operation due to its extreme noise output, and it has not been used, I
request to return it for a full refund.

Please provide me with a Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) number and
confirm the return shipping address in the United States. As per your
policy, I understand I will be responsible for return shipping costs.

 Order Number: Shop····

 Item: Jingle Miner BTC Hashcard (12.5 TH/s)

 Delivery Date: October 26, 2026

I look forward to your prompt reply and authorization to proceed with the
return.

Thank you,

Aikaterini S.

(address hidden)

(address hidden), Germany

(email hidden)
Note to the team: I'll look up the order first.

Dear Aikaterini,

Thank you for writing, and I'm sorry the Hashcard isn't right for your room.

The first thing I'd like to offer is a swap. Since the unit is unopened, we can put the value of the Hashcard towards a different miner, including the units we hold in Rotterdam, and you'd only settle the difference either way. If you tell me which model interests you, I'll price it exactly and arrange it.

If you would rather have your money back, I can't authorise that myself, so I won't give you an RMA number or a return address yet, and please don't ship anything until we confirm. I should be straight with you about the terms, because this is a change-of-mind return rather than a fault: return shipping would be at your cost, and a 10% restocking fee comes off the refund. My colleagues review and confirm these, and they are offline over the weekend, so they pick it up on Monday from 10am Eastern and you'll have their answer by email in this thread.

Nothing needs doing on your side in the meantime, and the unit is safe to leave boxed.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Good evening. I do not wish to receive a refund; instead, I would like a
device that does not make so much noise when in operation.
Please let me know which devices are available as a replacement.
I should also mention that I have already taken the device out of the box
and used it
—it is not in its original, unopened condition as you suggested. I look
forward to hearing from you.

Dear Aikaterini,

Thank you for telling me plainly that the unit has been out of the box and run. That makes a difference to how we handle it, and it is much better that I know now than later.

Here is what we can offer in your region. The Hammer Miner BC04 (6 TH/s) at $249 is in stock and ships within 2 business days. The Hammer Miner Thor P2 (10 TH/s) at $379 is not in stock today, it is a pre-order that ships by November 30. The Harlo H15 Dual at $799 and the Harlo B30 at $899 are also pre-orders shipping by November 30, and the Magic Miner 40T at $799 is a pre-order shipping by December 14.

I would rather not quote you decibel figures I cannot verify, so for a straight comparison of how loud each of these runs, our technical lead JD is the right person. He is quickest on our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, where he is @nullhashrate, and he can also answer here.

Tell me which unit you would like and a colleague is picking up the return of the Hashcard today, with the label and the exact amount your Hashcard puts towards the new one. Please keep it boxed until then.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

That's great, thank you.
